title: Home Purchase Financing Payoff Statements — Good-Through Dates Falling on a Weekend
content:
**Calendar convention — weekend good-through dates on Home Purchase Financing payoff statements**

Where the statement date plus the good-through period falls on a Saturday, the weekend roll is two days, moving the good-through date to the Monday; where it falls on a Sunday, the weekend roll is one day, also to the Monday. On any other day of the week there is no weekend roll.

The weekend roll is added in calendar days to the statement date plus the good-through period to give the good-through date.

| Day on which the statement date plus the good-through period falls | Weekend roll |
|---|---|
| Saturday | 2 days |
| Sunday | 1 day |
| Monday through Friday | none |

*Hypothetical dates (statement dated Monday 2026-05-04).* With a period of 26 days the date reached is Saturday 2026-05-30, so the good-through date is Monday 2026-06-01. With 13 days it is Sunday 2026-05-17, giving Monday 2026-05-18. With 15 days it is Tuesday 2026-05-19, which stands.
